proof_summary: A minimally transitive order-32 eight-point group P fails the individual-cycle block condition. An explicit increasing finitary wreath tower preserves P as the induced action on a bottom block. Every transitive subgroup must induce P there, so lifted crossing-cycle witnesses exclude every requested subgroup. The locally finite 2-group is its own transitive Sylow 2-subgroup.
